market_outlook.short_term: Choppy and event-driven. US CPI this week is the binary catalyst; rate-hike bets elevated post-162K jobs. Oil volatility from Iran/Hormuz dominates energy. Yen strength pressures global bonds. AI hardware leads while software lags. Expect 2-3% index volatility around CPI print. Trump-Warsh dynamic adds policy noise.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive for AI infrastructure, energy, and EM. Sovereign data center buildout (Saudi/UAE) and space compute create multi-year capex themes. Housing affordability crisis is structural, favoring rental and T-bill strategies. China stimulus cycle supports EM. Fed policy uncertainty persists but earnings growth (JPMorgan's Matejka thesis) supports equities on dips. Quantum and eVTOL remain early-stage but gaining institutional attention.
